LESSON: ACTS OF COMPASSION

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 5.2: Acts of Compassion
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 7

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Acts of Compassion, part of The Church in Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should you participate in Acts of Compassion?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm and list people with diverse needs in the community,

2. share experiences on occasions they helped the needy,

3. discuss ways Christians care and help the needy in the society,

4. explain the role of the church in helping the needy/destitute,

5. collect pictures of people showing acts of compassion, make a collage and display it in class,

6. read Leviticus 19:32-33 and Psalms 82:3 and list categories of people mentioned,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm and list people with diverse needs in the community,
2. share experiences on occasions they helped the needy,
3. discuss ways Christians care and help the needy in the society,
4. explain the role of the church in helping the needy/destitute,
5. collect pictures of people showing acts of compassion, make a collage and display it in class,
6. read Leviticus 19:32-33 and Psalms 82:3 and list categories of people mentioned,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Acts of Compassion together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: The skill of interacting with digital technology is exhibited as learners write a report using digital devices.

• Critical thinking and Problem-solving: The skill of research is demonstrated as learners identify a need in the community and

provide a solution.

• Learning to learn: The skill of working collaboratively is portrayed as learners visit the needy or the less fortunate and offer

help.

Values:
• Respect: The learners appreciate the needy and the vulnerable members of the society.

• Love: The learners participate in offering services to the needy and vulnerable members of the society.

• Responsibility: The learners show care and concern to the needy by visiting them and offering different services to them.

30

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Empathy: The learners identify a place (e.g. a hospital, a children’s home or home for the elderly), analyse the needs of the

people and organise a community service activity.

• Healthy inter and intra-personal relationships: The learners respect and care for the elderly members in their families, the

church or in the community.

• Skills building-helping people with special needs: The learners show love and concern for people with special needs by

visiting and attending to their needs.

Link to other subjects:

• Pre-technical Studies: The learners use digital devices to make PowerPoint presentations/slides.

• Social Studies: The learners in the company of the teacher or guardian identify and respond to the needs of the vulnerable

and destitute in the community.
